caption: The drawing depicts a single horseshoe, shown in two views and a cross-section, on a plain, light beige background. The largest portion of the drawing, located on the right side, features a realistic, shaded rendering of a metallic horseshoe in a dark gray hue, oriented at an angle, with several square holes around its outer edge and two larger rectangular openings in its center. On the upper left side of the composition, there is a more technical line drawing of the same horseshoe, showing the object from a top-down perspective with outline and internal structure visible, done in thin, precise pencil lines. Directly below this technical drawing is a short horizontal cross-sectional view of the horseshoe with its nail holes rendered as trapezoidal shapes, and below that is a short scale for measurement, marked with evenly spaced intervals and numbers. The name "HELEN HOBART" is inscribed in small letters in the lower left corner outside the main frame.
title: Flat Iron Holder
